_comment: ZeRO-3 variant, provided so you can MEASURE that it does not help. This is not the recommended config -- ds_config.json is. Run both at a longer --n-res and compare peak memory: stage 3 shards ~100k parameters across your ranks and leaves the O(N_res^3) triangle attention activation exactly where it was. The lesson is worth one experiment.
_precision_comment: bf16, matching ds_config.json -- DS4Sci_EvoformerAttention has no fp32 path.
_zero_comment: Stage 3 shards parameters as well as gradients and optimizer state, at about 1.5x the communication volume of stage 2. On a 100k-parameter trunk that buys essentially nothing and costs real bandwidth. Kept as a controlled experiment, not as advice. If stage 3 DOES help your run, the model you are training is not the one this lab ships -- check whether you raised c_z or the block count into real-parameter territory.
